|lore=Feared '''bounty hunter'''. Collected bounties on Solo from both the Empire and Jabba the Hutt. Took exquisite pleasure in using Solo’s friend to capture him.
|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Once during your control phase, may ▲ any card with 'Bounty' in title. Your cards with 'Bounty' in the title are immune to Aim High. May “fly” (landspeed = 3). Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Immune to attrition < 4.
|printings={{Card versions/Boba Fett}}
|notes=The Set 6 sources preserve this publication of Boba Fett. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20040615005231id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/v6changes.pdf interim supplement] gives the original-card qualifier. The January and October slips name Cloud City, and the remaster indicates Cloud City with its expansion symbol. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20040707195107id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/rulessheet020904.pdf#page=1 February 2004 ruling] verifies the same persona. Both full forms retain the Bounty pull, Aim High immunity, fly movement and conditional battle destiny.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20040619231451/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf Virtual Set #6 final revised sheet] (swccgpc.com, 12 January 2004; Internet Archive 19 June 2004; same file: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards6.pdf VirtualCards6.pdf] on res.starwarsccg.org), page 2, slip 29.
